solutions.title: Set backtracking
solutions.strategy: Track occupied columns and diagonals in sets while placing one queen per row.

timeComplexity.explanation: The search branches through permutations of columns, pruned by diagonal conflicts.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack and conflict sets store one row or diagonal entry per placed queen.

solutions.title: Bitmask backtracking
solutions.strategy: Use bitmasks for occupied columns and diagonals and choose available low bits row by row.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm still explores valid queen placements but prunes conflicts with constant-time bit operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack has one frame per row.
